LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.label: Aeon, the Wheel of Fate
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.description: Aeon continually simulates the changes of all things. Periodically, they randomly select a new story theme to adjust the simulation's test environment and observe how the colony evolves under different conditions.\n\nEach environment is only one part of the simulation. When a test cycle ends, the Wheel of Fate turns again, readjusting the test conditions and beginning a new simulation cycle.
